about.en: BtcUSD is a US dollar stablecoin issued by BTCFi and backed by deposited Bitcoin of various formats as collateral, letting Bitcoin holders borrow dollars against their BTC. It is not Bitcoin and not a Bitcoin price token. Its Base contract is 0xe4b20925D9E9a62F1E492e15a81dC0de62804dd4, where gTrade accepts it as collateral.
